title: Close remaining sparse tensor pre-canonicalization bounds
finding: Two related paths still violated the bounded-construction claim. SparseTensorEntry.evidence_sha256s flowed directly into _sorted_strings with no tensor ceiling, and TensorView.from_dict materialized every wire axis/entry with generator-to-tuple conversion before TensorView.__post_init__ could apply the existing axis/entry ceilings.
primary_claim: All known high-cardinality tensor construction surfaces, including wire deserialization and per-entry evidence fan-in, now apply their existing bounded-sequence guard before element materialization, copying or sorting.
gardener_decision: Reuse the existing _bounded_sequence construction guard at the remaining call sites rather than introduce an evidence collection or wire-decoder abstraction. The tensor remains a derived Fourfold/Forest projection and no authority moves into it.
acceptance: evidence digest count is checked before _sorted_strings can iterate or sort it
an oversized evidence sequence is rejected without element access
the exact 64-digest evidence ceiling remains accepted and canonically sorted
SparseTensorEntry.from_dict cannot bypass the evidence bound with a JSON list
TensorView.from_dict checks raw axis count before constructing TensorAxis records
TensorView.from_dict checks raw entry count before constructing SparseTensorEntry records
oversized wire axis/entry sequences are refused without element access
existing non-empty, duplicate-free sha256 validation remains delegated to the canonical schemas helper

requested: PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python -m pytest -q tests/twin/test_tensor_evidence_bounds.py tests/twin/test_tensor_construction_bounds.py tests/twin/test_tensor_kernel.py tests/twin/test_fourfold_contracts.py tests/twin/test_projection_verifier.py
verification.claim: source-level hardening plus focused regression preparation only until exact-head executable evidence exists

rollback: Revert the G1-TENSOR-01B commits; canonical Forest/Fourfold artifacts and their identities are unchanged.
